header.userPrompt:
Replace the `onRoleResolved` callback of `RoleAgents.resolveAll` with an Ox resource-only scope.

Background:
- `RoleAgents.resolveAll` (runner/src/main/scala/orca/runner/RoleAgents.scala) takes an `onRoleResolved: Agent[?] => Unit` callback, called after each role resolves, so that `buildContext` in runner/src/main/scala/orca/flow.scala can append each role agent to a `var roles` and close foreign (non-wired) role agents best-effort if a later step throws before ownership passes to `DefaultFlowContext` (see the `transferred` flag and the `finally` block calling `WiredAgents.closeBestEffort`).
- Ox 1.0.7 adds `resourceScope` (a resource-only scope, no forks) with `useInScope` / `releaseAfterScope` taking `using ResourceScope`. Orca pins Ox 1.0.5 in project/Versions.scala. Look up the exact 1.0.7 API before using it (e.g. with the cellar skill) — note that in 1.0.7 `useInScope` & co. take `ResourceScope`, not `OxUnsupervised`, and `resourceScope` cannot be started where a concurrency scope is visible.

Goal:
- Bump Ox to 1.0.7 and fix anything the bump breaks.
- Remove the `onRoleResolved` parameter and the `var roles` accumulator; express "close the wired agents and any foreign role agent if building the context fails" with Ox resource scoping instead (e.g. `resolveAll` taking `using ResourceScope` and registering each foreign role's release as it resolves). Keep the current semantics: resources are closed only when construction fails, ownership moves to the context on success, wired-backend roles are not double-closed, and an earlier foreign role is still closed when a later override throws. If a resource scope that always releases doesn't fit the "close only on failure" ownership transfer, pick the cleanest shape (e.g. moving scope ownership up so the scope spans the whole run and the context no longer closes agents itself) and record the reasoning in the relevant ADR/code comment.
- Also remove the `transferred` var if the new shape makes it unnecessary.
- Update RoleAgentsTest and any other tests/docs (AGENTS.md, ADR 0020) that mention `onRoleResolved`.
- Keep behavior otherwise unchanged; `sbt test` for the affected modules must pass.
